summary: Defines a way to carry SMTP Message Transfer Priority values through mail transfer agents that do not support the MT-PRIORITY extension. This lets the priority survive hops that would otherwise drop it. It is informational and not an Internet Standards Track specification.

eli5.summary: If some post offices ignore a rush sticker, you can hide the rush note inside the envelope so the next office still sees it.

questions: how to tunnel smtp mt-priority through old mail servers
